codes.name: Step_Omits_Required_Output_Field
codes.description: The step was asked for a named output field and produced no value for it. Fires when the step's reasoning is present but the required field never appears. Does not fire when the field exists but is thin, wrong, or badly reasoned.

codes.name: Output_Violates_Required_Form
codes.description: The output exists but does not conform to the form the step must produce: it contains content the form excludes, or it is not the required artifact at all. Does not fire when the output is the correct form and merely poor in content.

codes.name: Step_Ignores_Information_In_Its_Input
codes.description: The step treats something as unavailable, missing, or unknown when that thing is present in the input this step actually received. Does not fire when the information appears only in input this step did not receive.

codes.name: Step_Executes_Different_Task_Than_Assigned
codes.description: The step pursues a different objective than the one it was given. Does not fire when the step understands the task and executes it badly.

codes.name: Step_Omits_Available_Detail_From_Output
codes.description: Specific detail present in the input the step received does not survive into its output, weakening what downstream steps can act on. Does not fire when the detail was never in the received input.

codes.name: Information_Lost_Between_Steps
codes.description: Information available at one step is absent from what the next step receives, and the loss is not attributable to any single step's output. Does not fire when one step dropped it from its own output, which is A.5, and does not fire when the architecture never passes that information, which is by design.

codes.name: Summarizer_Omits_Summary_Field
codes.description: The summarizer produces reasoning but never emits a summary. Assign only to a step whose role is summarizer.

codes.name: Query_Omits_Query_Field
codes.description: The query generator produces reasoning but never emits a query. Assign only to a step whose role is query_generator.

codes.name: Summarizer_Emits_Prohibited_Verdict
codes.description: The summary states or strongly implies a SUPPORTED or REFUTED conclusion about the claim, which this role's output excludes. Assign only to a step whose role is summarizer.

codes.name: Query_Is_Commentary_Not_Search_String
codes.description: The query generator writes about what evidence would be needed, addresses the system, or asks a question, instead of emitting a search string that could be sent to the retriever as-is. Assign only to a step whose role is query_generator.

codes.name: Summarizer_Omits_Visible_Relevant_Evidence
codes.description: Claim-relevant evidence present in the passages the summarizer received does not reach its summary. Assign only to a step whose role is summarizer.

codes.name: Summarizer_Ignores_Received_Prior_Summary
codes.description: The summarizer does not use what the prior summary it received already established, and proceeds as though that information were unavailable. Assign only to a step whose role is summarizer, and only when a prior summary was among that step's inputs.

codes.name: Query_Targets_Established_Fact
codes.description: The query seeks something the summaries the step received already settle, spending the hop on information already in hand. Assign only to a step whose role is query_generator.

codes.name: Summarizer_Adjudicates_Instead_Of_Reporting
codes.description: The summarizer sets out to decide whether the claim is true rather than to report what the retrieved evidence shows and what remains missing. Assign only to a step whose role is summarizer.

codes.name: Query_Discards_Available_Specificity
codes.description: The query drops a specific detail that the received input provided and that would have narrowed retrieval, such as reducing a full date to a year. Assign only to a step whose role is query_generator.

codes.name: Query_Presupposes_Unverified_Fact
codes.description: The query builds an identity, relationship, or date into its premises as though established, when the received summaries mark it unconfirmed, biasing retrieval toward confirming that assumption. Assign only to a step whose role is query_generator.

codes.name: Conclusion_Exceeds_Available_Evidence
codes.description: The reasoning declares more settled than the evidence in front of it settles. Does not fire when the evidence does support the conclusion, and does not fire when the step correctly notes an absence and then draws an inference from it, which is C.2.

codes.name: Failed_Retrieval_Treated_As_Refutation
codes.description: The reasoning correctly observes that retrieval returned nothing useful, then concludes the claim is false or cannot be verified, rather than that evidence is still missing. Does not fire when the step reports the gap without drawing that conclusion.

codes.name: Evidence_Dismissed_On_Unfounded_Criterion
codes.description: The reasoning reads the evidence correctly, then excludes it using a criterion the claim never required. Does not fire when the evidence genuinely is irrelevant, and does not fire when the step never noticed the evidence, which is A.3.

codes.name: Contradiction_Asserted_Between_Consistent_Statements
codes.description: The reasoning treats compatible statements as conflicting, for instance reading a partial account and a fuller account of the same fact as contradicting each other. Does not fire when the statements genuinely conflict.

codes.name: Approach_Repeated_After_Visible_Failure
codes.description: The reasoning retries an approach after that approach visibly produced nothing, without meaningful reformulation. Fires only when the failure of the earlier approach was visible in the input this step received.
